data.summary:
Results-oriented Business Analyst with 4+ years of experience across requirements documentation, QA coordination, change management, and stakeholder communication in Agile and hybrid delivery environments.
Strong hands-on exposure to BRD, SRS, user stories, UAT planning, regression coordination, and production issue analysis.
Experienced in client-facing roles requiring documentation discipline, traceability, and controlled change delivery.

responsibilities: Act as a client-facing analyst for customization of IRT applications in global clinical trials.
Own requirement clarification, documentation, and validation across IT, Business, and external stakeholders.
Manage Software Change Requests (SCRs) including scope definition, feasibility checks, and impact analysis.
Prepare and review UAT plans, scenarios, and test cases aligned with client-specific guidelines.
Coordinate UAT execution, issue tracking, defect triage, and resolution with cross- functional teams.
Validate fixes and enhancements to ensure release readiness and quality compliance.
Support production issue analysis, documentation, and corrective actions.
Develop training materials, SOPs, and user documentation for internal and external users.
Maintain effective communication with internal teams and client stakeholders throughout delivery cycles.
Owned end-to-end requirement gathering for small to mid-scale product enhancements, bug fixes, and CRs.
Created and maintained BRD, SRS, user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, and validation rules.
Conducted GAP analysis, feasibility studies, and detailed impact analysis before development start.
Acted as the single point of contact between clients, product, QA, and development teams.
Supported manual testing activities, reviewed test cases, and validated test results.
Prepared release notes, user manuals, FAQs, and training documentation.
Supported clients during production issues, performed RCA, and ensured resolution closure.
Assisted in defining QA and documentation best practices within Agile (Scrum) framework and Waterfall methodologies.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Technical Project Analyst
IQVIA | Sep 2023 – February 2026
Act as a client-facing analyst for customization of IRT applications in global clinical trials.
Own requirement clarification, documentation, and validation across IT, Business, and external stakeholders.
Manage Software Change Requests (SCRs) including scope definition, feasibility checks, and impact analysis.
Prepare and review UAT plans, scenarios, and test cases aligned with client-specific guidelines.
Coordinate UAT execution, issue tracking, defect triage, and resolution with cross- functional teams.
Validate fixes and enhancements to ensure release readiness and quality compliance. • Support production issue analysis, documentation, and corrective actions.
Develop training materials, SOPs, and user documentation for internal and external users.
Maintain effective communication with internal teams and client stakeholders throughout delivery cycles.
Business Analyst
LOYLTWO3KS IT Pvt. Ltd. | Jul 2021 – Sep 2023
Owned end-to-end requirement gathering for small to mid-scale product enhancements, bug fixes, and CRs.
Created and maintained BRD, SRS, user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, and validation rules.
Conducted GAP analysis, feasibility studies, and detailed impact analysis before development start.
Acted as the single point of contact between clients, product, QA, and development teams.
Supported manual testing activities, reviewed test cases, and validated test results. • Prepared release notes, user manuals, FAQs, and training documentation. • Supported clients during production issues, performed RCA, and ensured resolution closure.
Assisted in defining QA and documentation best practices within Agile (Scrum) framework and Waterfall methodologies.
